result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of an introduction to a treatise treating a transcendental function by a new method applicable to any solution of a linear differential equation with algebraic coefficients, explaining how a complex variable z = x+yi is represented by points of a plane, the condition dw/dx = dw/(dy i), analytic continuation and multivalued (branched) functions such as log(z−a).
